page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c3d family. It features 90 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor with x86_64 architecture, consisting of 45 physical cores and 2 threads per core. The system is equipped with 720 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 3216 GB of NVMe SSD capacity spread across 8 local SSDs. No GPU accelerators are present on this instance.

Performance benchmarks indicate top-tier multi-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and software compilation with Clang scoring in the top 10% of tested systems. Cryptographic and extended instruction performance also rank in the top 10%. Memory bandwidth is strong, reaching 6368.24 GB/sec for cached read-only operations and 217.31 GB/sec for uncached large block reads, though large block write bandwidth is average at 77.28 GB/sec. Single-core performance and text processing benchmarks fall within the strong to average ranges.

This instance is designed for memory-intensive and high-throughput storage workloads. The combination of a high-density AMD EPYC processor, 720 GB of RAM, and fast local NVMe SSD storage makes it highly cost-efficient for resource-dense deployments that require high IOPS without the added cost of external storage. It is well-suited for large-scale database operations, Redis deployments, software compilation, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance designed for resource-intensive workloads. It is equipped with 90 dedicated vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor, 720 GB of RAM, and 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The architecture supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and cryptographic acceleration. Benchmark results show top-tier multi-core CPU performance, software compilation speeds, and cryptographic execution. Memory read bandwidth is highly competitive, though write speeds remain average. With its high memory-to-core ratio and fast local storage, this instance provides a balanced, high-density hardware profile without GPU acceleration. It is optimized for large databases, Redis caching layers, and parallel software compilation.
